SELECT "id", "account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:accounts}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("account_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("website"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("city"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  
  AND (NULLIF($6::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($6::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $4::text = 'account_name' AND $5::text = 'asc' THEN "account_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'account_name' AND $5::text = 'desc' THEN "account_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'city' AND $5::text = 'asc' THEN "city" END ASC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'city' AND $5::text = 'desc' THEN "city" END DESC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'country' AND $5::text = 'asc' THEN "country" END ASC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'country' AND $5::text = 'desc' THEN "country" END DESC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'annual_revenue' AND $5::text = 'asc' THEN "annual_revenue" END ASC, CASE WHEN $4::text = 'annual_revenue' AND $5::text = 'desc' THEN "annual_revenue" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $3::int OFFSET ((($2::int - 1) * $3::int))

SELECT "id", "account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:accounts}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("account_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("website"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("phone"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("city"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($2::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:accounts}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:accounts}} ("account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::numeric, $10::int, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:accounts}}
SET "account_name" = $2::text, "industry" = $3::text, "tier" = $4::text, "website" = $5::text, "phone" = $6::text, "city" = $7::text, "country" = $8::text, "owner_id" = $9::int, "annual_revenue" = $10::numeric, "health_score" = $11::int, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "account_name", "industry", "tier", "website", "phone", "city", "country", "owner_id", "annual_revenue", "health_score", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:accounts}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:accounts}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "account_name"::text AS label FROM {{table:accounts}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "account_name" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:accounts}} SET "owner_id" = $2::int, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "owner_id"
UPDATE {{table:accounts}} SET "health_score" = $2::numeric, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "health_score"
